name: Hidamari Care
description: Hidamari Care — a theme for a small senior care residence, laid out split-screen under a formal white top-bar header: the residence name and tagline on the left, the menu in one line and an Arrange a visit button on the right. Celadon (#7EBEAB) is the main colour: the rooms-and-care section, the contact section, every page head and the time marks are celadon fields in ink type. The front page is a day schedule: a white first screen with the headline top left and one edge-to-edge celadon day line with five time marks (7:00 to 19:00), each carrying a small stacked collage of a high-key photograph over an offset celadon card, alternating above and below the line; then the day hour by hour (time, what happens, who helps, a small photo), rooms and care on a celadon field where a transparent cut-out armchair breaks out of the framed room photograph, a monthly fees table, a two-week visiting calendar, two family quotes and contact and access. Photographs are realistic high-key images (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white backgrounds, pale shadows, graded toward celadon). Zen Maru Gothic for headings, Lora for text, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration 3d-clay is rendered as high-key photographs, because the 2026-10-18 rule asks commercial themes for realistic photographs; the stacked-collage vignettes are photo cards over offset celadon cards, and the break-frame object is a transparent cut-out armchair breaking out of the framed room photo.

fonts.role: headings, the residence name, time numerals and figures (Medium and Bold, Latin subsets); Japanese headings (Medium and Bold, subset to the characters of the Japanese sample text)
reading text, labels and tables (unmodified variable font file, weights 400-700; Reserved Font Name, so it is not subset)
